STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white square plate with a flat centre and a raised rim band. No curved inner wall is visible, so this is a flat square plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type cue: square plates are typically 20-30 cm. The plate looks medium-sized, not a large platter, so about 22-24 cm.
b) Reference cue: the plate spans roughly the length of a fork-sized object in the frame. The greens across the plate's width are about 2.5 of the chicken drumstick lengths (drumstick ~11 cm), giving roughly 25 cm, though the greens extend past the plate edge in places, so the true width is likely nearer 22-23 cm.
Reconciled width: about 23 cm square.

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Mixed raw leafy greens (mizuna/mustard-type leaves with some red pepper pieces and stems): they cover roughly 60% of the plate's area, about 0.6 x 23² = 317 cm². The greens form a fairly thin layer with some mounding in the centre, averaging about 2 cm thick. Volume ≈ 317 × 2 ≈ 630 ml. Mostly raw, bulk density 0.15 g/ml gives ~95 g. Some greens look wilted/cooked, so I'll use ~100 g.
- Chicken piece (one drumstick-style portion, skin-on, with a crumbed/nut-and-grain topping): about 10 cm long, roughly 2.5 cm thick, footprint about 40 cm². Grams ≈ 40 × 2.5 × 1.0 ≈ 100 g of meat and coating combined; I'll split as chicken ~75 g and topping ~35 g.
- Topping (crumb/grain and nut mix on the chicken): ~35 g.
- Sauce/dressing: a little visible glaze, ~5 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no clear base of rice or grains under the greens, and the plate is not heaped. No additional layer is added.

STEP 5 - Energy values (as served):
- Raw leafy greens with pepper: about 30 kcal/100 g.
- Roast chicken with skin: about 200 kcal/100 g.
- Crumb/nut topping: about 450 kcal/100 g.
- Sauce/glaze: about 120 kcal/100 g.

Totals: greens 100 g ≈ 30 kcal; chicken 75 g ≈ 150 kcal; topping 35 g ≈ 158 kcal; sauce 5 g ≈ 6 kcal. Total ≈ 344 kcal, about 215 g.
